blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A nursing graduate from Luna Goco Colleges has brought honor to Oriental Mindoro province by ranking ninth among the country’s top examinees in the Philippine Nurses Licensure Examination (PNLE) held last month. Alliah Benedictte Patolot Sibayan also marked a milestone for the Calapan-based Luna Goco Colleges, which was established in 1987.
